title: Pumpkin Ravioli in Chunky Tomato Sauce
subtitle: with Rocket and Parmesan
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the ravioli. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Shave the parmesan with a vegetable peeler.
Cook ravioli: Par-cook the ravioli in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins (they will finish cooking in the sauce). Reserve 80ml (⅓ cup) cooking water, then drain the ravioli.

Start sauce: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the garlic and half the Italian seasoning, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Add the tomatoes, reserved cooking water, half the tomato paste, 1 tsp red wine vinegar and 1 tsp sugar and bring to the boil (see Make it spicy).

Simmer sauce: Reduce the heat to medium and cook the sauce, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until thickened. Add the ravioli and cook, gently stirring, for 2 mins or until al dente and warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Put the rocket, 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp red wine vinegar in a bowl, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Add half the parmesan and gently toss to combine. Divide the ravioli among bowls and scatter with the remaining parmesan. Serve with the rocket salad and enjoy!
Make it spicy: If you like a kick of heat, add a pinch of chilli flakes to the sauce, or scatter over to serve if it's just for you.
